book.name: 1 Yoane
book.title: Yoane Yaromi Munom Ganom I Koma Boime

content: Ari mangi tai mapunom mapunom bire ime de teinga kam

Ena nenta “Yesu i Yai Gumam awi dongua akire di norongua Yai Mesia moime,” diro fi ki suwangua yaromi Yai Gumam wam apom moime. Te ari yokamai Nenom mun fi towainga yokamai Nenom gama ama mun fi erowaime.
Ena no yokamai denom minom Yai Gumam mun fi tere te kam di guwo dungua gore duwapunga ena firapunga no Yai Gumam gama ama mun fi erowapune.

Te no Yai Gumam kam di guwo dungua gore duwapunga ena no denom minom Yai Gumam mun fi topunga opom di moipune. Ena no ari Yai Gumam gama moipunga muruwo mangi tai mapunom mapunom bire topunga iran Yai Gumam ka di guwo dungua i ipun dekeme. Te no yokamai Yai Gumam fi ki si towapunga ena iran mangi tai niki dongua mapunom mapunom bire towapune.
Ena eramom mangi tai niki dongua bire towame? Nenta “Yesu i Yai Gumam wam kawom moime,” dire fi ki si towangua yaromi mangi niki dongua taikan muruwo bire towame.
Tai ta ta Yesu mapunom di mari dongua kam

Ena Yesu Kirisito nenen “Na fure nuwi bui narowangoro na akinam fera duwangoro goraiye,” diro u mari ume. Yaromi “Nuwi towane bui narowame,” diro kumie. Tamanume. Yaromi “Nuwi bui narowangoro akinam ama fera duwaiye,” diro u mari umie. Yai Gumam Murom ka kawom dungua kapakom moingua iran yaromi nenen Yesu kam i di mari dongua i kawom dume.
Ena iran Yesu nuwi bui tongua te akiyom fera dungua goingua te Murom kam dunguai tarom i suraiye ka towane dumie.
Nonon ari ka dinga fi ki si eropunba Yai Gumam wam di mari de norongua kam i mangi ari ka dinga bire erongua iran Yai Gumam kam fi ki si topune.

Ena no nonon Yai Gumam wam fi ki si topunga “Yai Gumam di mari de norongua kam i kawom dume,” dupunba ari Yai Gumam wam di mari de norongua kam fi ki si tekeinga yokamai “Yai Gumam i kasu dungua yai moime,” dime.
Ena Yai Gumam ka epe di mari de norome: Yai Gumam kakom kakom moi kuwom suwapunga inapunga nonon noromie. Te Yai Gumam wam kakom kakom moi kuwom sungua ingua kapakom moingoro
ena ari yokamai Yai Gumam Wam fi ki si towainga kakom kakom moi kuwom suwainga inaime. Te ari yokamai Yai Gumam Wam fi ki si tekenainga kakom kakom moi kuwom suwainga ikenaime.
Kakom kakom moi kuwom suwainga kam
Ena na “Ne yokamai Yai Gumam Wam fi ki si teinga ‘Nonon kakom kakom moi kuwom supunga ipunie,’ duwaime,” dire ka i boi ereiye.

Ena no mora kanupunga Yai Gumam nomanem te no nomanenom towane enapunga te no “Tai inapune,” ka make ei towapunga ena Yai Gumam taikan muruwo norowame. Ena iran nonon Yai Gumam ka make ei towapunga kuri fikenapune.
Te kakom kakom ka make ei towapunga Yai Gumam fimie. Nonon kanupunga Yai Gumam fingua iran ama kanupunga ka make ei toponga yaromi tarom i noromie.

Ena iran nenta ariyom ta kanangoro tai bei niki dowamba tarom i ariyom bei guwom akai de tekenangua ena yaromi Yai Gumam ka make ei towangoro Yai Gumam ariyom kakom kakom moi kuwom suwangua inangua towame. Na tai bei niki dowamba tarom i bei guwom akai de tekenangua kam diye. Te tai ta bei niki dowangoro tarom i bei guwom akai de towame. Na “Tarom i ka make eiyo!” dikeiye.

Te taikan muruwo niki dongua beinga i bianom faimba ari tai bianom faingua suwo koropane beinga kene kene eire guwom akai kimie. Kimba ari tai niki dongua towane beinga kene kene eire guwom akai naime.

Nonon kanupunga ari muruwo Yai Gumam gama moinga yokamai bianom faingua tarom dourom boikeimie. Ma deiyo! Yai Gumam Wam yokamai kiapanom nokapu bengoro ena iran yai ta bei niki dongua kapakom yokamai ganom bei niki de erekename.
Te nonon kanupunga nonon Yai Gumam gama moipunba bei niki dongua kapakom yaromi ari Yai Gumam fi ki si tekeinga yokamai muruwo kiapanom bei eromie.

Te nonon ama kanupunga Yai Gumam Wam mora u mangi uro inokore ei finga mapunom nonon norongoro ena iran nonon Yai Gumam ka kawom kapakom moingua fi kun daipunie. Te no yokamai Yai Gumam Wam Yesu Kirisito gere ama moipunga ena nonon te Yai Gumam ka kawom kapakom moingua yaromi gere ama moipunie. Te Yai Gumam ka kawom kapakom moingua yaromi kakom kakom moi kuwom sungua ingua kapakom ama moime.
Ena na ganamao, ne yokamai yai gumam kasu waninga muruwo mounom wako ereiyo! Mora epe.
